essence: Between-bodies fit-yoked; once-shone stays same; death-signs listed; yoked yet unfallen; taught quickly Śiva at once; stepped resorting ends Śiva-made; mid-way death allowed; fallen rests returns Śiva; missing yet rejoicing.

sections.SUMMARY: Heaven-hell-made, between bodies, fitness-yoked onward. Once-shone in knowing-time stays same past body-fall. Death-signs: senses stolen, memory lost, breath choked. Yoked yet unfallen from self-truth. Taught quickly from teacher-mouth: keen-graced, unblocked Śiva. Stepped resorting roots in truth, ends Śiva-made. Mid-way death allowed the yearning. Fallen rests a world-lord, returns Śiva next birth. Missing yoga yet rejoicing long in god-pleasures.

rasa.dominant: śānta of death faced and succession assured
rasa.justification: Dying well, falling well, returning well: peace.
